title: User registration with valid credentials
steps: 1. Switch to register; 2. Enter full name, unique email, password; 3. Submit
expected_result: User registered; JWT saved; redirected to home dashboard with display name

title: Anonymous guest access to platform
steps: 1. Enter guest name; 2. Click continue as guest
expected_result: Guest JWT issued; redirected to home dashboard with Guest badge

title: Login with invalid password rejection
steps: 1. Enter valid email and incorrect password; 2. Submit
expected_result: Error toast displayed; user remains on /login; 0 tokens stored

title: Guest profile query boundary check
steps: 1. Call GET /users/me with guest JWT token
expected_result: Returns guest user profile details; currently returns 404 User Not Found (BUG-003)

title: Home dashboard controls and metrics
steps: 1. Navigate to home URL /
expected_result: Navigation bar renders display name

title: Sign out clears session state
steps: 1. Click logout; 2. Confirm in modal dialog
expected_result: Session cleared from localStorage; redirected to login/welcome view

title: Host creates new video meeting room
steps: 1. Click new meeting; 2. Enter title, duration, capacity; 3. Submit
expected_result: Meeting created; joining screen resolves; user connected in WebRTC room

title: In-call microphone toggle and hand raise
steps: 1. Click mic toggle; 2. Click hand raise button
expected_result: Mic enabled attribute toggles; hand raise queue state set to active

title: In-call real-time chat message delivery
steps: 1. Open chat tab; 2. Enter text; 3. Click send
expected_result: Message appears in chat stream; should align right as You (BUG-008)

title: Host creates meeting agenda item
steps: 1. Open agenda tab; 2. Enter title and duration; 3. Save
expected_result: Agenda item saved and rendered in sidebar item list

title: Host creates interactive voting poll
steps: 1. Open polls tab; 2. Enter question and 2 options; 3. Launch
expected_result: Poll card rendered in sidebar with 0 total votes

title: Join meeting by lowercase room code
steps: 1. Enter lowercase room code; 2. Click join
expected_result: Room resolves and user enters room; currently hangs indefinitely (BUG-009)

title: Mobile web responsive layout adaptation
preconditions: User in meeting room on mobile
steps: 1. Resize viewport to 412x915; 2. Open mobile drawer tabs
expected_result: Mobile header and inline mobile action buttons render properly

title: IDOR metadata and room code leakage check
steps: 1. User B queries GET /meetings/:id with valid token
expected_result: Access denied; currently returns 200 with private room code (BUG-001)

title: Room code case sensitivity lookup
steps: 1. Query GET /meetings/code/:code with uppercase vs lowercase
expected_result: Both cases resolve to room UUID; currently lowercase returns 404 (BUG-002)

title: Adversarial input fuzzing on meeting title
steps: 1. Submit 10k title, XSS script tags, SQL injection string
expected_result: Payloads safely stored or blocked without 500 server crash

title: Boundary limit validation on duration and capacity
steps: 1. Submit duration -10, 0, 1440; capacity 0, -1, 500
expected_result: Invalid bounds return 400 Bad Request; valid bounds return 201 Created

title: WebSocket handshake authentication enforcement
steps: 1. Connect to /meetings with garbage JWT token
expected_result: Handshake rejected; currently connects and allows speaking spoofing (BUG-004)

title: Anonymous guest voting in active poll
steps: 1. Host creates poll; 2. Guest emits poll:vote
expected_result: Vote counted; currently throws unhandled Prisma FK crash P2003 (BUG-006)

title: Host moderation over anonymous guests
steps: 1. Host emits meeting:kick, media:force-mute, make-cohost
expected_result: Host moderates guest; currently fails or throws Prisma P2025 (BUG-005)

title: Solo host brief disconnect grace period
steps: 1. Disconnect socket for 2.5s; 2. Query REST status
expected_result: Meeting preserved with grace period; currently deleted immediately (BUG-007)
